import os,json,hashlib,subprocess,stat
from pathlib import Path
src=Path('/usr/local/sbin/fadego-password')
root=Path('/srv/projects/fadego')
directory=root/'tools'
dest=directory/'fadego-password'
expected='7e0e991ec3ad6d79ef38f2f8b97c8e5659e069e58c112e9d9a2b5121299e5a2b'
o={'operation':'isolate_fadego_admin_helper','moved':False,'vault_untouched':True}
created=False
names=('ssh','nginx','postgresql@16-main','pink-iptv-backend','pink-vpn','fadego-staging','lowcost-europa','pm2-iptvpn-bot','pm2-telegram-robot-leads')
def live():
 return {n:subprocess.run(['systemctl','is-active',n],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=7).stdout.strip() for n in names}
try:
 assert os.geteuid()==0 and root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink()
 assert src.is_file() and not src.is_symlink() and not dest.exists() and not dest.is_symlink()
 assert hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,'source file was changed'
 content=src.read_bytes()
 assert content.startswith(b'#!/usr/bin/env bash') and b'/usr/local/sbin/fadego-password' not in content,'self-reference would break move'
 assert b'BASH_SOURCE' not in content and b'dirname "$0"' not in content and b'dirname "$1"' not in content,'relative-runtime script not safe to move'
 assert subprocess.run(['/bin/bash','-n',str(src)],capture_output=True,timeout=9).returncode==0,'source syntax invalid'
 before=live();assert all(s=='active' for s in before.values()),'critical service not fully healthy'
 if not directory.exists():
  directory.mkdir(mode=0o700)
  created=True
 assert directory.is_dir() and not directory.is_symlink() and directory.stat().st_uid==0
 assert directory.stat().st_mode&0o077==0
 assert src.stat().st_dev==directory.stat().st_dev,'cross-device move not atomic'
 os.rename(src,dest);o['moved']=True
 assert dest.is_file() and hashlib.sha256(dest.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
 assert dest.stat().st_uid==0 and stat.S_IMODE(dest.stat().st_mode)==0o700
 assert subprocess.run(['/bin/bash','-n',str(dest)],capture_output=True,timeout=9).returncode==0
 after=live();assert before==after and all(s=='active' for s in after.values()),'service status changed'
 assert not src.exists()
 o.update({'status':'MOVED_AND_VERIFIED','destination':str(dest),'old_global_path_absent':True,'active_services':len(after)})
except Exception as e:
 o.update({'status':'NOT_COMPLETED','reason':type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)[:175]})
 if o['moved']:
  try:os.rename(dest,src);o['rolled_back']=True
  except Exception:o['rollback_failed']=True
 if created:
  try:directory.rmdir()
  except OSError:pass
print(json.dumps(o,separators=(',',':')))
